title: Nanny Hours vs Contracted Weekly Cap
dataSources: brightwheel check-ins (`brightwheel:checkin`), Procare attendance (`procare:attendance`), Huckleberry sleep logs (`huckleberry:sleep`), daycare incidents (`daycare:incident`), and nanny timesheets (`nanny:timesheet`).
app: brightwheel check-in exports, Procare attendance logs, Huckleberry sleep tracking, daycare incident reports, and nanny timesheet entries streamed into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=nanny:timesheet hours_worked=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats sum(hours_worked) as weekly_hours by _time caregiver_name
| eval over_cap=if(weekly_hours>40,weekly_hours-40,0)
| where over_cap>0
| sort - over_cap
description: Detects weeks where logged nanny timesheet hours exceed a forty-hour contracted cap.
value: Overtime in childcare billing adds up fast; a weekly cap view keeps invoices predictable.
implementation: Export nanny timesheets with `hours_worked` and `caregiver_name`, then alert when weekly totals exceed your contract.
visualization: Table of weeks and caregivers with overtime hours.
grandmaExplanation: It tracks when nanny hours went over the weekly limit you planned for.
